text:
[LFST.7.5.2] Two events happening at the "same wall-clock instant"
in two different tiers — say two `CacheSet`s produced
by different tiers — have no spec-defined relative
order beyond what falls out of per-stream `seq` plus
each event's `clock_ns`. Tools reconstructing a whole-
site view merge streams and apply whichever
reconciliation suits them (wall-clock on `clock_ns`,
causal via values the facts carry ([LFST.7.2.4]), or both).
